text: ASICS Corporation's principal shareholders as of 30 June 2026 were The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 16.13%), Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 8.57%), THE CHASE MANHATTAN BANK, N.A. LONDON SECS LENDING OMNIBUS ACCOUNT (2.73%) and Nippon Life Insurance Company (2.56%); GOVERNMENT OF NORWAY held 2.13% and GIC PRIVATE LIMITED 1.39% — no state or sovereign shareholder is listed as controlling the company.
short: ASICS Corporation's top holders are trust banks and institutions; no state control.
